checks: Factoring the t Jacobian gives T of shape m+1 and independent Beta(1,m) proportion; the event is Z+(p+b)U≥b, so its conditional tails have precisely the stated cutoff and power.

The convolution gives e^w/2^k for negative w and e^(−w)Σ(2w)^j/j! divided by 2^k for positive w. The ratio-density factor T changes the integral to the factorial (m+j+1)!, giving the stated binomial coefficients and continuous match at zero.
The moving upper terms cancel and the lower term is zero. Each fractional-linear substitution gives the claimed range and coefficient of t, with positive-side common denominator c^(k+1).
The beta integrals produce m+j+1 and m after rescaling. Expanding V0(1+p)−2pA and V0(1+p)+A[k(1−p)+2p(k−1)] gives N0c and D. The geometric-sum formula therefore cancels the entire N0 contribution.

Independently integrated both original rational density pieces termwise in 1−z and 1+z with Fraction. The final primitive matched in 24 cases, including k=m and k=7. Source b2bd978e973816b6 §§1–3 has the same distribution, domain and residual term.
